title: BILLY SHARP RETIRED IN OCTOBER. BY NOVEMBER HE WAS BACK.
description:
A hat-trick, a goodbye, a comeback. All inside about three weeks.

Billy Sharp is forty and has signed for AFC Rushden and Diamonds. James Clifton is suspended, so Sharp steps in against Burton Albion in the FA Cup. His last game before retiring was a hat-trick against Peterborough. Even boy bands wait longer than three weeks.

He has 299 career goals, and one more is a nice round number. Just saying. Chris Wilder says Sharp still keeps himself very fit, so maybe retirement was a rest day.
